violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Walk-in cooler: milk 50F, precook turkey sausage 56F, precook eggs 54F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items above was moved to a cooling unit that maintains 41F and below.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rail warmer: turkey sausage 119,97
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Items above was discarded.

violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AVAILABLE AT HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS REPLACED DURING INSPECTION

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN WALK-IN COOLER: COOKED EGG AT 54F, CREAM CHEESE AT 51.4F, FAT FREE MILK AT 52.3F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS FOODS INCLUDING THOSE MENTIONED ABOVE DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION. UTILIZE COLD-HOLDING LOGS PROVIDED BY EHS. CEASE HOLDING TCS FOODS OVERR 41F.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED ICE CREAM SCOOPS STORED IN ROOM TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. DUNKIN DONUTS/BASKIN ROBBINS (Inspection Date: 07/03/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK-IN COOLER. OBSERVED WALK-IN COOLER AT 48F-55.6F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOUL ODOR FROM GREASE TRAP/DRAINS UNDER THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. GREASE TRAP MUST BE CLEANED SOON AND REGULARLY AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE PIPES UNDER THE THREE-VAT SINK TO NOT BE DRAINING. WHEN SINK IS TURNED ON, WATER POURS DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. WATER MUST BE ABLE TO DRAIN PROPERLY. SINK/PLUMBING SYSTEM MUST BE REPAIRED.
